versions.changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-video-publish skill for automated Douyin (TikTok China) video publishing.
- Provides step-by-step browser automation instructions for uploading videos, setting titles, adding hashtags, and selecting location.
- Includes best practices for video size, title length, and hashtag usage.
- Offers troubleshooting tips for common upload errors and checks to avoid duplicate posts.
- Quick checklist added for streamlined publishing preparation.
